newsitem.title: USA: Louisville feeder cattle steady-up $1 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Louisville feeder cattle steady-up $1 - USDA.

text.p: Feeder steers were steady to $1.00 per cwt higher, compared to last week's close, USDA said. Feeder heifers were steady to firm.

Feeder Steers - Medium and Large 1 600-700 lbs 64.25-72.50, including 16 head blacks 643 lbs 72.50; 700-800 lbs 64.75- 70.10, including 51 head 747 lbs 70.10. Small 1 300-400 lbs 59.00-63.50. Holstein Large 2 500-600 lbs few 58.75; 8 head 783 lbs 56.50; 17 head 868 lbs 55.00; 17 head 1018 lbs 55.25.
Feeder Heifers - Medium and Large 1 600- 700 lbs
